user_saw: With the xAI plugin enabled, the model picker and `openclaw models list --all` showed the same models under both `xai` and `x-ai`.
summary: The fix declares `x-ai` as a catalog alias of `xai` and canonicalizes static fallback rows before deduplication.
reasoning: I checked PR #139649 and found that it began appending static fallback rows to the published catalog after failed discovery while preserving their original provider IDs. The reported live-discovery case follows a separate path, and the `x-ai` runtime alias predates the shallow boundary. The available offline history does not establish when live discovery first published both IDs or whether it previously listed each model once.
